Gifts scenario

Build a tasteful red envelope and gift table.

Use this scenario when the couple wants a gift area that feels festive, organized, and easy for guests to understand.

Best forGift table
Main decisionPresentation
Products laterEnvelope sets, keepsakes
Open checklistAll resources

Keep it organized

The gift table should have clear placement for envelopes, cards, keepsakes, and any family gifts. A clean layout often feels more premium than a crowded table.

Product categories

Useful product angles include red envelope sets, card boxes, table signs, small keepsake trays, and printable bilingual notes.
